title: 地錨自由段與錨碇段驗證~Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
focus: 地錨自由伸長、錨碇傳力與試驗可識別性~Anchor free extension, bond transfer and test identifiability
summary: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。~Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function.

units.title: 自由段伸長的機理與驗證~Free-length extension mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 自由段讓鋼腱在不與周圍漿體黏結的區間彈性伸長，張力才能有效傳到遠端錨碇區。試驗伸長比預期小，可能代表自由段黏住或有效長度不足；比預期大則可能包含座頭滑移、鋼材模數差異或錨碇段移動。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。~The free length allows elastic tendon extension without bond to surrounding grout, transferring tension to the distant anchorage zone. Less extension than expected may indicate unintended bond or inadequate effective length; excessive movement may include head slip, modulus differences or movement within the bond zone. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、自由長Lf=12 m、E=195 GPa、鋼面積A=0.001 m²，δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, free length Lf=12 m, E=195 GPa and steel area A=0.001 m², δ=PLf/(EA)=0.0369 m=36.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以獨立基準量測腱端位移，扣除座頭變形後比較彈性卸載回復量與理論自由伸長。試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。~Measure tendon-end movement from an independent reference, subtract head deformation and compare elastic unloading recovery with theoretical free extension. Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor.
units.failure: 自由段局部黏結可能讓錨力過早傳入滑動土體，拉力讀值合格仍不能提供設計的整體穩定作用。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。~Unintended free-length bond may transfer force prematurely into moving ground; an acceptable tension reading then fails to provide the intended overall stabilization. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.
units.misconception: 地錨達到試驗荷重就代表自由段長度一定正確。~Reaching test load proves that anchor free length is correct.
units.practice: 試驗報告需保留升降載曲線與基準穩定證據；地工設計者確認自由伸長範圍後才接受地錨。此式假設鋼材彈性且自由段不黏結，量到的總位移還包括其他柔度；不能用總位移直接倒推唯一自由長度。~Retain loading-unloading curves and reference-stability evidence; the geotechnical designer confirms the free-extension range before accepting the anchor. The expression assumes elastic steel and unbonded free length; measured total movement includes other compliance and cannot uniquely identify free length by itself.

units.anchor: 錨碇平均剪應力~Mean bond shear
units.title: 錨碇平均剪應力的機理與驗證~Mean bond shear mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 錨碇段透過鋼腱與漿體、漿體與地層兩個界面把張力傳入穩定土岩。平均剪應力可作尺度檢查，實際沿長度的分布並不均勻，近端先動員後可能逐步滑移；增加錨碇長度也不保證容量一直線性增加。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。~The bond zone transfers tendon force through tendon-grout and grout-ground interfaces into stable soil or rock. Mean bond shear checks scale, but distribution along the length is nonuniform and may progressively slip after mobilizing near the loaded end. Increasing bond length therefore does not guarantee indefinitely linear capacity growth. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設P=600 kN、漿體直徑D=0.15 m、錨碇長Lb=8 m，平均τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For P=600 kN, grout diameter D=0.15 m and bond length Lb=8 m, mean τ=P/(πDLb)=159 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 結合鑽孔地層、注漿紀錄及載重試驗，檢查錨碇區是否均在設計地層，觀察持載位移是否穩定。設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。~Combine bore geology, grouting records and load tests to confirm the bond zone lies in the intended stratum and assess sustained-load movement stability. Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length.
units.failure: 假設直徑大於實際或錨碇區跨入弱層，會高估有效接觸面積，造成漿土界面逐步滑移。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。~Overstated diameter or a bond zone crossing weak soil exaggerates effective area and may allow progressive grout-ground slip. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.
units.misconception: 平均黏結應力低就表示每個位置都不會局部滑移。~Low average bond stress prevents local slip at every position.
units.practice: 設計黏結參數須由代表性試驗支持；地層異常與注漿量偏差應交地工設計者核定錨碇長度。平均剪應力不是可直接使用的黏結強度，兩個界面及鋼材都要檢查；短期試驗結果亦不能自動涵蓋長期潛變。~Support design bond parameters with representative tests; the geotechnical designer reviews anomalous strata and grout volumes before confirming bond length. Mean shear is not a usable bond strength; both interfaces and steel require checks, and short-term testing does not automatically cover long-term creep.

units.title: 試驗位移組成的機理與驗證~Test-movement components mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 試驗儀器讀到的是整套載重鏈的變形，包括鋼腱伸長、座頭壓縮、楔片滑移及錨碇區移動。不同成分可能有可逆及不可逆部分，必須透過獨立測點與卸載回復辨別；把總位移全歸給自由段會掩蓋錨固異常。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。~The instrument measures deformation of the full loading chain: tendon extension, head compression, wedge slip and bond-zone movement. These components include reversible and irreversible parts, requiring independent points and unloading recovery for separation. Assigning total movement to the free length alone can conceal anchorage defects. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設自由段伸長δf=36.9 mm、座頭變形δh=3.0 mm且無其他變形，δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With free extension δf=36.9 mm, head deformation δh=3.0 mm and no other movement, δtotal=δf+δh=39.9 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分別量測腱端、承壓板及獨立基準位移，將可逆回復與殘餘位移分列，確認反力架本身穩定。測點配置圖應與儀器校正一併核准；試驗負責人確認基準未受反力影響後，再把資料交設計者判讀。~Measure tendon end, bearing plate and independent reference separately, separating elastic recovery and residual movement and verifying reaction-frame stability. Approve the measurement layout with calibration; the testing lead confirms that reaction loads do not affect the datum before submitting results for design interpretation.
units.failure: 反力架或量測基準移動會造成假伸長，可能誤判自由段合格或把不穩定錨固當作材料彈性。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。~Reaction-frame or datum movement creates false extension and can misclassify unstable anchorage as acceptable free-length or material elasticity. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.
units.misconception: 試驗位移計只會讀到鋼腱本身的彈性伸長。~The test displacement gauge reads only elastic tendon extension.
units.practice: 測點配置圖應與儀器校正一併核准；試驗負責人確認基準未受反力影響後，再把資料交設計者判讀。相加模型依賴各位移的方向與共同基準，未量測的錨碇滑移不能預設為零；算例僅示範如何分解量測。~Approve the measurement layout with calibration; the testing lead confirms that reaction loads do not affect the datum before submitting results for design interpretation. The sum requires consistent directions and datum; unmeasured bond slip cannot be assumed zero, and the exercise only illustrates decomposition of observations.

units.anchor: 穩定區錨碇~Anchorage in stable ground
units.title: 穩定區錨碇的機理與驗證~Anchorage in stable ground mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地錨必須把力傳過潛在滑動面，錨碇區若仍在可移動土體內，只會拉緊同一塊不穩定土。穩定區位置依地下水、開挖及地震情境而變，單一最短距離並不足夠；應在三維剖面上核對自由段與錨碇段相對各失穩面的位置。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。~Anchors must transfer force beyond potential slip surfaces. A bond zone inside moving ground merely tightens the same unstable mass. Stable-zone location changes with groundwater, excavation and seismic cases, so one minimum distance is insufficient; check free and bond lengths against relevant three-dimensional failure surfaces. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設沿錨軸滑面交點距頭部16 m、錨碇末端22 m，滑面後長度L=22−16=6 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: If a slip surface intersects the anchor axis 16 m from the head and the bond end is at 22 m, length beyond the surface is 6 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以鑽孔及地層模型確認滑面位置，檢查不利水位與施工階段下的變化，將錨碇段逐支投影。地錨圖應標出主要及敏感度滑面；地下水或開挖深度變更時，由地工設計者重新核對穩定區。~Confirm failure-surface position using borings and the ground model, assess adverse water levels and construction stages, and project each bond zone individually. Anchor drawings show principal and sensitivity slip surfaces; groundwater or excavation-depth changes require geotechnical review of stable anchorage zones.
units.failure: 採用錯誤滑面位置會把有效錨長算得過長，整體滑動時地錨可能與擋土體一起位移。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。~An incorrect slip surface overstates effective anchorage length, allowing anchors and the retained mass to move together during global instability. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.
units.misconception: 錨碇段越長就一定能補償它位於滑動土體內的問題。~A longer bond zone always compensates for being located within moving ground.
units.practice: 地錨圖應標出主要及敏感度滑面；地下水或開挖深度變更時，由地工設計者重新核對穩定區。六米只是幾何位於滑面後的長度，不是已證明的有效黏結長；需確認該段材料、注漿完整性及群體穩定。~Anchor drawings show principal and sensitivity slip surfaces; groundwater or excavation-depth changes require geotechnical review of stable anchorage zones. Six metres is geometric length beyond the surface, not demonstrated effective bond length; material, grout continuity and group stability still require confirmation.

units.title: 傾角分力的機理與驗證~Inclination components mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 斜地錨同時提供水平及垂直分力，水平分力抵抗擋土需求，垂直分力則進入牆體與基礎。角度增加可能增加向下荷載而減少水平效率，錨頭局部承壓及牆趾承載因此需要一起評估，不能只看鋼腱拉力大小。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。~An inclined anchor supplies horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component resists retaining demand, while the vertical component enters the wall and foundation. Steeper inclination can increase downward loading while reducing horizontal efficiency, requiring combined assessment of head bearing and toe capacity rather than tendon force alone. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.
units.model: 原創教學假設：張力T=600 kN、對水平夾角θ=25°，H=Tcosθ=544 kN，V=Tsinθ=254 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For tension T=600 kN at θ=25° below horizontal, H=Tcosθ=544 kN and V=Tsinθ=254 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測實際錨頭方向與鑽孔傾角，核對牆體承壓細部及基礎垂直反力，檢查是否與模型一致。任何錨角變更都須同步更新水平效率與垂直荷載；牆體及地工設計者共同確認後才核准。~Measure actual head direction and bore inclination, checking wall-bearing details and foundation vertical reactions against the model. Every angle change updates horizontal efficiency and vertical loading; wall and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the revised arrangement before approval.
units.failure: 忽略垂直分力會低估牆體軸力或基礎需求，角度誤差也可能讓錨頭承壓產生偏心。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。~Omitting the vertical component understates wall axial or foundation demand, and angular error can introduce eccentric head bearing. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.
units.misconception: 所有地錨張力都可以直接當成水平擋土支撐力。~All anchor tension can be counted directly as horizontal retaining resistance.
units.practice: 任何錨角變更都須同步更新水平效率與垂直荷載；牆體及地工設計者共同確認後才核准。分力分解只處理力方向，未評估錨頭偏心或牆體變形相容；兩個分量必須放入同一結構自由體圖。~Every angle change updates horizontal efficiency and vertical loading; wall and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the revised arrangement before approval. Component resolution addresses direction only, not head eccentricity or wall compatibility; both components must enter the same structural free body.

units.title: 持載潛變的機理與驗證~Sustained-load creep mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地錨在固定荷載下仍可能因土體潛變、漿土界面滑移或鋼腱鬆弛而產生位移。位移對時間對數的斜率可用於比較持載階段，但不同荷載與時間區間不能混用；量測須排除溫度及反力架變形的影響。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。~Anchors can move under constant load through soil creep, interface slip and tendon relaxation. Displacement versus logarithmic time helps compare hold stages, but different load levels and time intervals are not interchangeable. Temperature effects and reaction-frame movement must be separated before interpreting the trend as anchorage creep. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設t₁=1 min時δ₁=1.2 mm、t₂=10 min時δ₂=2.1 mm，斜率α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm/對數週期。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For δ₁=1.2 mm at t₁=1 min and δ₂=2.1 mm at t₂=10 min, α=(δ₂−δ₁)/log₁₀(t₂/t₁)=0.9 mm per logarithmic cycle. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 保持核定試驗荷載並精確記時，用獨立位移基準及溫度資料檢查持載趨勢，避免中途重設零點。潛變判據應引用核定試驗程序的荷載與時距；試驗負責人將完整時間序列交地工設計者判定。~Maintain the approved test load and precise timing, using an independent movement reference and temperature records to assess hold trends without rezeroing mid-stage. Creep criteria reference the approved test load and timing; the testing lead supplies the full time series for geotechnical interpretation.
units.failure: 位移持續加速可能表示黏結區逐步破壞；若只讀起終點而漏掉中間資料，會錯過不穩定變化。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。~Accelerating movement may indicate progressive bond failure; reading only endpoints misses unstable behaviour within the hold period. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.
units.misconception: 固定荷重時出現的位移全部都是鋼腱彈性伸長。~All movement under constant load is elastic tendon extension.
units.practice: 潛變判據應引用核定試驗程序的荷載與時距；試驗負責人將完整時間序列交地工設計者判定。對數斜率只適用於指定持載區間，不能直接外推多年壽命；此數值不是任何規範的通用合格上限。~Creep criteria reference the approved test load and timing; the testing lead supplies the full time series for geotechnical interpretation. The logarithmic slope applies to the specified hold interval and cannot directly predict years of life; this number is not a universal code acceptance limit.

units.anchor: 腐蝕截面損失~Corrosion area loss
units.title: 腐蝕截面損失的機理與驗證~Corrosion area loss mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地錨鋼腱承受長期拉力，腐蝕不只減少截面，也可能因點蝕形成應力集中。圓鋼直徑均勻減少的平方關係可說明面積敏感度，真實多股鋼絞線卻常呈不均勻損傷，防蝕套管、錨頭密封與排水因此需要連續管理。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。~Tendons carry sustained tension, and corrosion both reduces area and introduces pitting stress concentrations. The squared relation for uniform circular diameter loss illustrates area sensitivity, but multistrand tendons often deteriorate nonuniformly. Sheathing, head sealing and drainage therefore require continuity of protection and long-term management. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設圓鋼直徑剩原值90%，面積比A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81，均勻面積損失19%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: If a circular bar retains 90% of original diameter, A₂/A₁=(0.90)²=0.81, representing 19% uniform area loss. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 檢查可接近錨頭的密封與積水，依核定方法評估鋼材狀態，將局部點蝕與均勻損失分開紀錄。交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。~Inspect accessible head seals and standing water, assess steel condition using approved methods, and record localized pitting separately from uniform loss. Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails.
units.failure: 密封破損可讓水沿套管進入，外部錨頭外觀良好仍可能有隱藏腐蝕與拉力能力下降。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。~A broken seal can admit water along the sheath; a sound-looking external head may coexist with concealed corrosion and reduced tension capacity. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.
units.misconception: 鋼腱直徑減少百分之十，面積也只減少百分之十。~Ten-percent tendon diameter loss produces only ten-percent area loss.
units.practice: 交接應列防蝕系統、可檢查部位與異常處置責任；發現密封失效時由地錨設計者核定檢測及修復範圍。面積比不是殘餘拉力能力保證，點蝕、應力腐蝕與鋼絞線斷絲可能更不利；不可僅按平均直徑折減。~Handover identifies protection systems, inspectable areas and response responsibility; the anchor designer determines testing and repair when sealing fails. Area ratio does not guarantee residual tensile resistance; pitting, stress corrosion and broken wires may be more adverse than a mean-diameter reduction.

units.title: 地錨群體作用的機理與驗證~Anchor-group interaction mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 多支地錨的錨碇區若互相重疊，地層應力與潛在破壞面會互相影響，單支試驗容量不能直接乘支數。群體效率可作簡化比較，但實際效果取決於間距、方向、層位與載入順序，必須與整體滑動及土體變形共同檢查。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。~Overlapping anchorage zones interact through ground stress and potential failure surfaces, so single-anchor test capacity cannot automatically be multiplied by anchor count. Group efficiency gives a simplified comparison, but spacing, orientation, strata and loading sequence govern the actual effect, requiring checks of overall movement and ground deformation. The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設4支各R=600 kN、合成群體效率η=0.8，Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For four anchors each with R=600 kN and assumed group efficiency η=0.8, Rgroup=η×4R=1920 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在三維圖上檢查錨碇區間距，對比不同錨的試驗與監測反應，核對共同滑面及鄰地權界線。群體效率與錨距應有分析或試驗依據；新增地錨前由地工設計者重審共同破壞機制及地下界面。~Check bond-zone spacing in three dimensions, compare test and monitoring responses between anchors, and assess common slip surfaces and property boundaries. Support group efficiency and spacing with analysis or tests; the geotechnical designer reviews common failure mechanisms and underground interfaces before anchors are added.
units.failure: 群體錨碇區形成共同破壞體時，單支都曾試驗合格仍可能整體滑動，力分配也會變得不均。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。~A common failure mass can move despite individual test passes, and interaction can produce unequal force distribution among anchors. The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis.
units.misconception: 多支地錨總容量永遠等於每支容量直接相加。~Total capacity of several anchors always equals the direct sum of individual capacities.
units.practice: 群體效率與錨距應有分析或試驗依據；新增地錨前由地工設計者重審共同破壞機制及地下界面。效率係數是本例假設，不是固定材料性質；群體穩定不能只靠一個折減值取代失穩面與變形分析。~Support group efficiency and spacing with analysis or tests; the geotechnical designer reviews common failure mechanisms and underground interfaces before anchors are added. The efficiency is assumed for this exercise rather than a fixed material property; one reduction factor cannot replace group failure-surface and deformation analysis.

units.title: 錨頭座入損失的機理與驗證~Head-seating loss mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 錨頭楔片座入或承壓構件壓縮會縮短鋼腱有效伸長，造成鎖定力下降。自由段越短，同樣座入量引起的力損失越大，因為軸向剛度較高；施加峰值因此需要與鎖定後實際保留力分開記錄。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。~Wedge seating or bearing-component compression reduces tendon extension and retained force. For the same seating movement, a shorter free length loses more force because axial stiffness is higher. The applied peak must therefore be recorded separately from the force actually retained after lock-off and verified against the intended load-transfer state. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：E=195 GPa、A=0.001 m²、自由長Lf=12 m、座入s=0.002 m，ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For E=195 GPa, A=0.001 m², Lf=12 m and seating s=0.002 m, ΔP=EAs/Lf=32.5 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測鎖定前後腱端與承壓板的相對位移，對照載重計或核定提離試驗，排除溫度變化。驗收需保留座入與保留力紀錄；地錨設計者核定補償及再驗證條件，現場不得只追求較高峰值。~Measure relative tendon-end and bearing-plate movement across lock-off, compare with load cells or approved lift-off testing, and separate temperature changes. Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone.
units.failure: 座入未計入會使保留力不足，後續牆體位移才重新動員地錨，失去預力限制變形的效果。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。~Omitted seating loss leaves insufficient retained force, requiring later wall movement to remobilize the anchor and reducing its deformation-control benefit. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.
units.misconception: 座入量很小，所以不可能顯著影響短自由段地錨。~Small seating movement cannot significantly affect a short-free-length anchor.
units.practice: 驗收需保留座入與保留力紀錄；地錨設計者核定補償及再驗證條件，現場不得只追求較高峰值。線彈性式未含摩擦與錨碇段變形，並假設座入全轉成自由段回縮；實測保留力仍是必要的獨立證據。~Acceptance retains seating and retained-force records; the anchor designer approves compensation and reverification rather than pursuing a higher peak alone. The elastic expression excludes friction and bond deformation and assumes all seating shortens the free segment; measured retained force remains necessary independent evidence.

units.title: 試驗文件覆蓋的機理與驗證~Test-evidence coverage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地錨的隱蔽性使施工與試驗文件成為長期可追溯性的核心，缺少一支資料不能由其他地錨平均合格來補足。資料完整率有助找出待處理清單，卻不代表品質合格率；荷重程序、校正、時間及地層證據都須逐支核對。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。~Because anchors are concealed, construction and test records are central to traceability. Missing evidence for one anchor cannot be replaced by average compliance elsewhere. Completeness ratios identify unresolved items but are not quality-pass rates; loading procedure, calibration, timing and geological evidence must be checked anchor by anchor. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設應有50支地錨完整紀錄、已確認48支，文件覆蓋率48/50=96%，仍有2支未解決。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: If complete records are required for fifty anchors and forty-eight are confirmed, coverage is 48/50=96%, leaving two unresolved. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將每支地錨編碼連結鑽孔、注漿、材料與試驗資料，抽核原始曲線及簽認，保留缺件清單。未解決地錨須逐支指定責任及補證方式；地工設計者與業主確認處置後，才可完成正式移交。~Link each anchor identifier to drilling, grout, material and test evidence, audit original curves and signatures, and retain an explicit missing-record list. Assign responsibility and a resolution method to every unresolved anchor; formal handover follows joint confirmation by the geotechnical designer and owner.
units.failure: 只報高完整率可能掩蓋關鍵位置缺乏證據，日後維修時無法判斷原有荷載與防蝕系統。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。~Reporting only a high completeness rate can conceal missing evidence at critical locations, preventing later interpretation of original loading and corrosion protection. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.
units.misconception: 文件完整率達到百分之九十六就等於全部地錨合格。~Ninety-six-percent documentation coverage means every anchor is acceptable.
units.practice: 未解決地錨須逐支指定責任及補證方式；地工設計者與業主確認處置後，才可完成正式移交。比率只描述資料覆蓋，不衡量試驗結果或構造安全；缺少資料的地錨須保留未判定狀態，不可自動補成通過。~Assign responsibility and a resolution method to every unresolved anchor; formal handover follows joint confirmation by the geotechnical designer and owner. The ratio describes evidence coverage, not test outcome or structural safety; anchors with missing evidence remain unresolved rather than being automatically marked as passing.

example: 原創教學例：假設地錨自由長Lf=12 m、鋼面積A=0.001 m²、彈性模數E=195 GPa，在P=600 kN時，理論自由伸長δ=PLf/(EA)=36.92 mm。若張力提高10%至660 kN而其他量固定，δ=40.62 mm，也提高10%。這只對自由段線彈性伸長成立，試驗總位移還含座頭坐入、反力架及錨碇變形。應以獨立基準和卸載回復分離各成分，不能把總位移直接倒算為唯一自由長度，更不能用此算例作現場試驗荷載指令。~Original teaching example: take free length Lf=12 m, steel area A=0.001 m² and modulus E=195 GPa. At P=600 kN, theoretical free extension is δ=PLf/(EA)=36.92 mm. Increasing force by 10% to 660 kN with other inputs fixed gives 40.62 mm, also a 10% increase. This applies only to elastic free-segment extension. Total test movement also includes head seating, reaction-frame motion and bond-zone deformation. Separate these using independent references and unloading recovery; total movement cannot uniquely identify free length, and these assumed numbers do not prescribe a field test load.
history: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
